name: agent-chat
useFor: Put a conversation in `ChatPanel` (title, `onClose`, `footer` for the composer; `framed` for the cut corner and header nodes). In the empty state show `MapStrip` and `ChatSuggestions`; wrap the composer in `SurveyFrame` and put `ChatFollowUps` on it after an answer. `ProfileChart` draws an elevation profile in ticks.
constraints: Sliding parts in; they enter in place
A chat without the site it is about
title: Agent chat
description: The Ask Mireye panel built from the system's parts: the panel, a map strip, suggestions, follow-ups, the survey frame and an elevation profile.
